grid_note: (6,9,13) is asymmetric in all three axes so an axis transposition cannot cancel
initial_field: discrete-equilibrium27 + gaussian rho/u perturbation + 1e-3 non-equilibrium noise; the SAME float64 array is handed to both sides
reference_stream: definition_stream27 (numpy np.roll pull streaming, refcore27) -- pinned against the repo streaming kernel separately (arm S0)

reference_collisions.srt: lbmpy create_srt(compressible=True, continuous_equilibrium=False): discrete 2nd-order Maxwellian, the convention of tensorlbm.d3q27.equilibrium27
reference_collisions.mrt_repo: lbmpy MomentBasedLbMethod over the moment polynomials reconstructed from the repo's own _M_D3Q27_DATA, rates = collide_mrt27 documented defaults [0,0,0,0,s_e]+[1/tau]*5+[s_q]*9+[s_eps]+[s_pi]*7
reference_collisions.cumulant: lbmpy create_with_default_polynomial_cumulants (Geier 2015), continuous Maxwellian equilibrium, non-shear groups relaxed with 1
reference_collisions.cumulant_discrete_eq: same cumulant relaxation, discrete 2nd-order Maxwellian equilibrium

arm_classification.probe_rationale: A5 relaxes the cumulants of f_neq (not the full distribution) with omega=1 for non-shear groups, so its fixed point is feq rather than feq's cumulant image. Whether it coincides with the lbmpy full-cumulant rule at omega=1 for non-shear groups is exactly what the probe measures; the outcome is reported, not tuned.

predeclared_thresholds.interpretation: PASS iff every gated arm is below gate_fp64_code_equivalence at every (grid, tau, seed) AND every positive control exceeds control_detection_min AND the MRT basis identity holds AND the streaming pin is exact AND the shear-wave decay error is < 15% (owner caliber) with the 3% target reported separately. The convention probe A5 has no gate: its measured gap and amplitude scaling exponent are reported as the finding.

controls.C1_tau_perturbation: reference evaluated at tau*(1+1e-3) instead of the arm's tau -- must be detected
controls.C2_wrong_equilibrium_convention: reference SRT built with continuous_equilibrium=True -- must be detected
controls.C3_direction_mispermutation: arm sees a population-rotated field (roll by one direction) -- must be detected
controls.C4_streaming_omission: reference step without streaming -- must be detected

stopping_rule: one pass; no threshold, sweep range or seed is changed after the first results are seen. Any gated arm above its gate is reported as FAIL and is not re-tuned. The probe arm is reported as measured.
variables_changed: collision model: BGK / TRT / MRT(native rates) / cumulant Geier / cumulant legacy
amplitude sweep {0.002, 0.01, 0.05, 0.15} for the convention-attribution fit
variables_held_fixed: equilibrium: discrete 2nd-order Maxwellian on the reference side of the gated arms
input PDF field bit-identical for both sides (single float64 array)
fp64 throughout; float32 sensitivity reported separately (not gated)
confounders: direction ordering differs between lbmpy and TensorLBM -- handled by deriving the permutation from velocity tuples (bijection asserted)

the cumulant reference's equilibrium convention (continuous vs discrete Maxwellian) changes the order>=3 equilibrium cumulants; this is why A4 is compared against the discrete-equilibrium cumulant reference and the continuous one is reported as a second, non-gated number
floating-point summation order differs between a vectorised torch reduction and a scalar generated expression: irreducible round-off, bounded by the fp64 gate

MRT rates are the repo's own defaults (s_e=1.19, s_eps=1.4, s_q=1.2, s_pi=s_e); the basis is reconstructed symbolically from the repo matrix, so a wrong repo basis would show up here rather than being assumed
repetitions: 2 seeds x every (grid, tau) for the gated sweep; the gate uses the worst seed, the table reports both. The deviation is round-off dominated, so 2 draws suffice to separate round-off from a systematic defect by >8 orders of magnitude.
